arc.name: First CLI prototype
singleSeams: A pure summarizer owns counting; the CLI owns stdin and exit codes.
honestyRails: No runtime dependencies; do not claim unrun tests.

acceptanceCriteria.signal: Empty and mixed completed/open tasks produce exact JSON counts; repeated calls agree.
acceptanceCriteria.bar: Expected counts, help exit0 and unknown-option exit2 pass real stdin tests.

phase.name: Build the tested CLI prototype
phase.stakeholderDemo: Pipe task input into a CLI and read exact counts.

flag.justification: The standalone CLI is the product entry point; there is no runtime switch.

tasks.title: Implement the input-to-summary behavior

steps.description: Add the pure task summarizer with integer total/done/open counts → verify: npm test
Read stdin, emit one JSON line, handle help and invalid options → verify: npm test
Test empty and mixed input, repeat calls, help and invalid options using real stdin → verify: npm test
Document usage, architecture and testing → verify: README names the command and expected JSON output

acceptanceCriteria: Real stdin tests assert exact counts for empty and mixed input.
Help exits0; invalid options exit2 with stderr.
README describes invocation and the pure-core/CLI boundary.
